about: The subset of cairn's wallet contract the open server serves (open-server.ts): the route entries copied verbatim, the node's and the resolver's stub answers for them copied verbatim from cairn's upstream fixture, with two /block/height answers constructed from its recorded indexer blocks for the header route, which the open server reads from the node. Regenerate from the cairn commit below, never by hand.
shapeSyntax: A key is a path into the parsed body: `a.b` a member, `a[]` every element of an array, `a.*` every value of an object used as a map, the empty key the body itself. `fieldReads`, where present, lists where the wallet reads each field. A `?` after a segment marks what the wallet tolerates absent; if present it must have the type. A required path must match at least one value. A type is integer, number, string, boolean, object, array, null, hex20 (0x and 40 hex digits), hex32 (0x and 64), digits (a string of decimal digits), alternatives joined by |; `=<json>` is a value the wallet compares against, `one-of:a,b` one of those strings. `lengths` gives an array's exact length.

routes.reads: core/node.ts:76 tip() is Number(height ?? 0): a missing height reads as tip 0, against which fees are priced and leases lapse. core/namespv.ts:852 the header sync reads tip().height. A non-2xx throws and wallet.tip() is null.

core/node.ts:101-105 balance(), before every spend and for the shown balance: a body without a utxos array refuses the spend as VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE; confirmed_balance is the balance shown (missing reads 0); truncated marks a list the node cut. vendor/cairnx-spv.js:3547 selectInputs spends a coin only with confirmations >= 1 and a positive safe-integer value, so a missing confirmations leaves every coin unspendable; txid and vout name the coin whose source tx is then fetched and recomputed (rpc-tx).

core/node.ts:110-118 confirmedUtxos(), from core/history.ts:297 (a pending row whose coins are gone): only a 2xx with a utxos array counts, and truncated true makes the list incomplete; a 404 falls back to /utxos only on a bare node origin, so through cairn a 404 reads as unknowable and the row stays open.

core/node.ts:263-292 verifyOne, for every input before signing: 404 is a coin to skip, 503 with code SCAN_HORIZON a coin to skip, any other non-2xx refuses the spend as transient; the body's tx is rebuilt from version, locktime, app, inputs and outputs and must recompute its txid, else the whole spend is refused as tampered, and a number JSON cannot hold exactly is its own verdict, so the bytes must reach the wallet unchanged. core/node.ts:80-94 txInclusion reads ok, height and complete. core/namespv.ts:934 the name proof binds a record's spent coin from tx.

core/node.ts:80-94 txInclusion, for the history rows (display only): only ok true with state mined, pending or unknown is used, and mined needs a safe-integer height. core/inclusion.ts:24-31 inclusionVerdict reads definite only for unknown: definite true with an input missing from the mined coin set marks the row spent (gone after two tips, core/inclusion.ts:37-47); anything but true reads as no reading, so a dropped send's row never closes. For mined and pending definite is not read. A 404 sends the wallet to /tx/:id, which only a bare node origin needs; any other non-2xx or body leaves the row open.

cases.name: unknown, the node's scan stopped short

routes.reads: core/namespv.ts:916-921 blockAt and core/fillspv.ts read the body as text under the client's byte cap; vendor/cairnx-spv.js:967-1002 bindBlockBody parses it exactly (u64 fields above 2^53 included), refuses ok false, rebuilds each tx's txid from version, locktime, app, inputs and outputs, refuses a field not written the way the node writes it, and matches the merkle root of the header the wallet verified. A non-2xx throws: the name or fill check fails closed.

core/node.ts:95-97 getProposal returns proposal (or a flat body carrying payload_hash), null on any non-2xx; core/claims.ts:148 and core/wallet.ts:1062 take a payload_hash as mined before they reveal or register content; core/cairnxview.ts:150-158 attestTargetView reads proposer, domain, uri and payload_hash for a cancel's title (display only).

core/node.ts:33-74 post() and 559-596 signAndSubmit, after signing: a 2xx JSON object is the answer, ok with err or error (the echoed txid is a cross-check only, the wallet's own txid is used); a 4xx is a refusal before any node; a 5xx, a network error or an unreadable body is "may already be in flight". An err naming "already present" or "mempool conflict" is a pending duplicate. The body is {tx} with hashes and scripts as byte arrays.

core/namespv.ts:646-662 headersBatch: a 429 waits Retry-After, a 502 or 503 retries, any other non-2xx throws; the headers array must hold exactly count rows, each {header, hash}, and the light client checks every header (prev link, PoW, LWMA bits) before use; core/namespv.ts fetchChunk serializes each header for the stored chain.

core/names.ts:31-74 resolveName, a send to a name: a 404 from the primary is "not registered", any other failure asks clarvis, whose 404 is not taken as definitive; lapsed sends the name to the two-source check; addr must be 0x and 40 hex, and the address is then proven from name-history (trade-name-history).

core/namespv.ts:292-301 fetchNameHistory, per source: a 404 is unregistered at that source, any other non-2xx or ok not true makes it unusable; events are the txids and heights the wallet proves against its own headers; resolve is compared with the proven answer, never trusted; scopedReplaySufficient false fails closed.

core/namegate.ts:16-23 readNameRecord, before a renew or a set primary: a 404 is no record (both are refused, the fee would burn), any other non-2xx is no verdict; core/namegate.ts:34-61 nameActApproveGate reads owner, pending, expired and lease.inGrace.
As 0.3.3, and core/namegate.ts:69-81 nameRecordCaution, before a transfer or a profile write, also reads locked (an open offer holds the name).
